what.text: This page follows refugees from Liberia in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5117 Liberian refugees, and Côte d'Ivoire hosted 22.6% of them.
After Côte d'Ivoire, the largest hosts are the United States, Ghana and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Liberia in 1989 and 1990, with the NPFL, and from 2000 to 2003, with LURD and MODEL.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1997.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1988 at 30 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 797834, at the end of 1994.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
